notes.title: Hotfix for Content Patch #6
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Kills with fire from Green Balls now gives armor
Level 18 weather tower was sometimes visible after loading a save where it should be destroyed, this should now be fixed
Assflies stop buzzing after gibbed
Flameguard's fuel tank hitbox fixed
Militia shields no longer block Green Balls
Updated the waterfall in Level 13, new residents coming soon
Exploit and geometry fixes
Some visual upgrades

notes.title: Content Patch #6
notes.notes:
It's been a while, but we have a new patch! This one includes Cold Front, the third level of Chapter 4.

Also included:

Kantele, the last SISU weapon
Two new enemy types, K-9 Scattershot (shotgun dog) and the Organ Farm Shield Variant
Upgraded projectile for Green Balls
Lots of texture and animation upgrades (enemies, weapons, props, etc.)
Visual upgrades to older maps
Cloud Saves

notes.title: Hotfix for Content Patch #5
notes.notes:
Various level fixes
Visual adjustments on level 3 and 2
Minor asset adjustments

notes.title: Content Patch #5
notes.notes:
The end continues. This update includes the second level of the last chapter.

Other stuff in the update:

Updates to old levels
Graphical improvements, including textures and animations
Enemy reskins and the return of a greasy bastard
Bugfixes
Minor adjustments to game balance

The next level is well under way and will introduce the last SISU weapon, the mythic Kantele.

notes.title: Hotfix for Content Patch #4
notes.notes:
Small fixes for Level 16:

Start/end screens
Collisions
Roadside death sound

notes.title: Content Patch #4
notes.notes:
The end begins NOW. This update includes the first level of the last chapter.

Other stuff included in the update:

New SISU weapon, the Green Balls
Minor graphical updates to older assets
Bugfixes

These last levels will be released one-by-one as they are finished. Be sure to keep an eye for the next one, where the Final Union is revealed!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.63a
notes.notes:
Thanks for feedback on the new levels!

Fixes/changes:

Goblin laser visual no longer goes through walls
Swan Tank now gives 25 armor, tweaks to its melee damage
Added secret triggers to levels 4 & 14
Fixed light pole skip in level 9
Fixed enemies spawning under the map & some collisions in level 11
Level 11 sauna now heals
Fixed acid pools in level 12
Water in level 14 is now lethal & bursting pipes don't reset after loading a save
Fixed some collisions & lighting in level 15 and improved fan puzzle readability
Hakita remixed music for level 15
Added goodies folder

notes.title: Content Patch #3
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 comes to a close! This patch includes the following:


Levels 14 and 15
Two new enemy types and a boss
Re-balances to older enemies, including new attack patterns
Level updates and fixes, mainly to Chapters 1 and 3
Lots of texture and animation upgrades

Have fun with the new content and be sure to give feedback, more is coming very soon!

notes.title: Content Patch #2
notes.notes:
The wait is over!

White Hell is looking a lot greener this time of year, as our inebriated adventurer, Jarmo, has found himself in another dimension.

Now he has to face the armies of Tuoni, the local Death God, who threatens his home from beyond the borders of reason.

New content:

3 fantastical levels set in a new dimension
6 enemy types with new behaviors and mechanics
2 SISU weapons: Oculus Rifle and The Squirreler


Fixes & updates to old stuff:

Level 10 music
Enemy texture/mesh updates
Environmental texture updates & geometry fixes
New Sword of Destiny
Player & weapon texture/animation updates

notes.title: Content Patch #1
notes.notes:
The first content patch/update is here! With it comes:
- Level 10, the conclusion to Chapter 2
- a new boss
- a new special enemy
- lots of tweaks, balancing, and fixes
- UI and QoL updates

Now that Chapter 2 is done, we'll be able to focus on the next five levels. They will take Jarmo (and you) somewhere ...else.

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.notes:
- fixed collisions in level geometry and objects
- adjusted sniper damage
- small rebalancing in levels 5, 6 & 8

notes.title: Early Access & Demo Update Coming
notes.notes:
Greetings!

White Hell is entering Early Access later this summer. The demo is also getting an update to better reflect the current state of the game.

More information about changes and release dates later, be sure to follow the Steam Community Hub, Discord, Twitter, and YouTube for updates.

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Fixes:
- exploits in level geometry
- rebound controls are now saved after quitting
- hand model doesn't disappear when close to a wall
- default resolution is now set to main monitor resolution, should fix menu & aiming issues

Additions:
- hand model shows damage on low health
- player death screams
- [spoiler]it's a secret![/spoiler]
- tutorials & button prompts

Reworks:
- Fast Grunts are now Knife Jugglers

Tweaks:
- Grunt & Officer animations
- base music volume
- general game balance
- chandeliers are easier to hit
- level 1 wall textures
- shotgun spread & damage
